# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

<!-- cap-evolve:meta-insights-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001 (first iteration of the run)
- Strategy tried: (1) fan out one read-only subagent per failing trajectory + one over all passing tasks; (2) pull GOLD final DB state straight from tau2 `tasks.json` (ids map 1:1 to trajectories) instead of inferring from prose; (3) empirically execute the PATCHED tool bodies against the real airline DB in the tau2 venv, both on the failing inputs (does it fix?) and on the passing inputs (does it regress?). No LEDGER rows yet — can't cite a val move, but every code fix is DB-verified rather than argued.
- What separated confident from shaky fixes: clusters whose failure is a deterministic arithmetic/state miss (baggage 12, payment 25) are ideal for in-body guards — you can PROVE the fix and PROVE no regression by re-running. Clusters whose failure is a missing decision (rebook-cancel 23) or an eval-termination artifact (37/40) can't be verified the same way; 23 got a plausible prompt rule, 37/40 were ruled out as edit-space-unwinnable.
- Plateau/stall signal: n/a (first iteration).
- What to try next iteration: read this candidate's RESULT first. If 12/25 fixed but 23 didn't, the prompt-rule lever is weak for split-reservation logic — consider a composite/validation tool instead of more prose, and do NOT keep expanding the prose (risk to passing modify tasks). Do not attempt 37/40 without a framework change to the episode-termination (see FRAMEWORK_IMPROVEMENTS).
